summary: Both supplied occurrences fit inherited II.1 bedauern, bejammern. The 6/22 and 30/138 contexts are already the two Infectum examples; neither is printed again.

In 6/22 the experiencer u babo is the ordinary subject; ʕal hayo supplies the cause/topic of lamenting. The later ʕal qarʕe d ruḥe belongs to coordinated gmoḥe and must not be assigned as another complement of kəmḥayəf.
30/138 has plural experiencers in kəmḥayfi; the following wish supplies the regretted situation. Narrative past time in the edition does not change the kə-marked form’s Infectum classification.

The inherited etymology compares a Turoyo nominal expression, Arabic ḥayf ʕalayhi and Kurdish heyf lêhatin. The occurrences attest an inflected Stem II verb; they do not choose between contact sources or demonstrate a separate light-verb construction.
The inherited note with komətḥayafno is retained verbatim as unstructured draft material; neither present occurrence establishes its Detransitive status or relation to another entry.
